# Ocean Fish Market

> Brooklyn's trusted source for fresh, wild-caught seafood since 1994. Delivered to NYC, Long Island, Westchester, and New Jersey. Order online or call (646) 750-9232.

Founded by Slavik, Ocean Fish Market sources premium wild-caught fish from trusted waters around the globe. Three retail locations plus a large-scale wholesale operation. Online orders sold by the pound with a 5 lb minimum. Payment via Zelle or Venmo at (646) 750-9232 — delivery within 24 hours.

- [Home](/): Brand story, featured catch, ordering rules, and contact.

- [Chilean Sea Bass](/fish/seabass): Patagonian toothfish, whole or filleted.
- [Branzino](/fish/branzino): Mediterranean sea bass from Greece and Turkey.
- [Grouper](/fish/grouper): Atlantic grouper fillets, steaks, whole.
- [Flounder](/fish/flounder): Atlantic flounder.
- [Tilefish](/fish/tilefish): Wild Atlantic tilefish.
- [Whiting](/fish/whiting): Whole, butterfly, and head-off whiting.
- [Mullet](/fish/mullet): Coastal mullet, whole and steaks.
- [Buffalo Fish](/fish/buffalo): Mississippi River buffalo fish.
- [Carp](/fish/carp): Fresh carp for traditional preparations.
